site_notes: Riocentro drop off Riocentro Parking Map : Enter through Lot G - parking allowed in Lots C & G Conference Center Map Riocentro Map Riocentro has gender-neutral restrooms on the second floor of Pavilion 3 and Pavilion 4 . Attendees can also make use of the family restrooms and single-stall accessible restrooms located throughout the conference center ; one of the accessible restrooms is located on the second floor above the registration desks, across from Room 204 A/B.

Registration and Badge Pickup You will be able to pick up your badge at the registration desk located in the Convention Center Foyer see the schedule for times You wil need your registration QR code and a form of identification. No Badge Sharing - if caught the badge will be confiscted until the 2nd badge has been purchased for the attendee sharing your badge. Lost Badge Fee - USD $100 - refundable if original badge is found and both badges are presented within 24 hours of the newly printed badge.
Food and Beverage The conference will provide a morning and afternoon break. Breakfast and Lunch can be purchased from vendors in outdoor area. See the schedule for the times

Luggage Check There will be a luggage check across from the registration desk. Plan to pick up your luggage 15 minutes before the end time to avoid missing the deadline. Luggage not picked up will be available the next day. Luggage left at the end of the conference will be turned over to the convention center. April 23 7am-8pm April 24 through 27 7am-5:30pm

Personal Conference Programs This year, ICLR partners with scholar-inbox.com to provide all ICLR attendees customized conference programs based on personal research interests to more easily navigate the conference sessions. scholar-inbox.com is a community-driven paper recommender system developed by researchers for researchers. Registration at scholar-inbox.com is easy and fast. The personalized programs can be accessed from any mobile device or PC via the web browser. Scholar inbox is coming soon...
